_comment: 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.3): the Horns' camp at the ruin, attached to ruin_surface's `ceria_dig_camp` NPC. This is a SEPARATE graph file, not extra nodes inside ceria_intro.json, because a conversation graph is one file (game.gd keys dialogue_graphs by basename) and always opens at its own `start` -- there is no per-entity start-node override, so camp_hub could never be reached through ceria_intro's hub. The split is also what the place-naming validator wants: the horns_dig GIVER maps (ceria_intro: inn + dungeon_approach) stay disjoint from the join_dig PRODUCER map (ruin_surface), so quests.json's join_dig beat is held to naming the ruin. SPOILER RULE: no line here names a door; the reveal is the pedestal's open_toast. NO door_retrieved text_variant lives here, and the reason CHANGED in Task 2.7: the camp NPC's present_when now carries `absent: {door_mounted: 1}` (it was door_retrieved, which banks one event before the reveal open_toast and so popped Ceria off-screen mid-quote -- see that entity's own _comment). The camp therefore SURVIVES the haul window, from door_retrieved until the door is hung. A past-tense arm here would be wrong for a different reason than before: through that whole window the haul is still in progress, and the moment it is over the camp is gone. Spec section 8's past-tense arm stays on ceria_intro's hub, at the inn -- now carried by the `ceria_inn_returned` row, which gates on door_mounted, so it is first reachable at the mounting and never during the dig. Task 2.6 backfills door_mounted for migrated saves, so they still see no camp.

camp_hub.speaker: Ceria
camp_hub.text: You made it. Camp rules: nobody touches anything shiny, nobody wanders past the survey stakes alone. The sealed level's below the pedestal court. We found the site off an old expedition ledger -- half the pages were about what they DIDN'T bring out.
